headline: Executive order creates a federal working group to review how the government keeps imported products safe.
what_it_does: This order sets up a group of federal agencies to look at how the government checks the safety of products brought into the United States from other countries. The group is meant to review current rules and practices and suggest ways to improve them. The title alone does not spell out which agencies take part or what specific changes, if any, would follow.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that oversee imports and product safety
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to work together in a joint group to review import safety practices.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that import goods into the United States
who_it_affects.how: They could face changes in safety checks or rules if the group's review leads to new policies.

who_it_affects.group: Consumers who buy imported food, toys, and other goods
who_it_affects.how: The review is aimed at the safety of imported products they use.

when_it_takes_effect: July 18, 2007, when the order was signed
